title: DMRC Recruitment 2026 – Senior Engineer, Supervisor, Engineer Posts
shortInfo: DMRC has announced notification for Senior Engineer, Supervisor, Engineer posts. Required qualification: Govt Org/Railways/PSUs/Metro exp in Arch, Civil, Env, Signaling. Last date to apply: 04-11-26.

dates.event: Last Date of Receipt of Application
Shortlisted Candidates List Upload (Tentative) (Second Week of November, 2026)
Final Result Declaration (Tentative) (Fourth Week of November, 2026)

howToApply: Download the application form from the DMRC website: http://www.delhimetrorail.com
Fill in the application form (Annexure-I) in capital letters with all required details.

Attach all relevant documents including educational certificates, work experience certificates, last promotion order, copy of PPO, NOC from present employer, D&AR and Vigilance clearance (Annexure-II), and APARs of last 05 years.
Candidates presently employed in Govt. organization/Railways/PSUs/Metro organizations must send their application through proper channel along with Vigilance and D&AR clearance.

Send the duly filled application form in an envelope superscribing the Name of Post prominently, through Speed Post to: Additional General Manager/HR/P, Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Ltd., Metro Bhawan, Fire Brigade Lane, Barakhamba Road, New Delhi, latest by 04/11/2026.

OR email the scanned copy of duly filled Application Form along with scanned copies of all other documents to: career@dmrc.org, indicating the Advt. No. DMRC/PERS/22/HR/2026/235 in the subject of the email.
Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date shall be summarily rejected.

title: NPCIL Recruitment 2026 – CA/CMA Intern Posts
shortInfo: NPCIL has announced notification for CA/CMA Intern posts. Required qualification: Inter CA, Inter CMA. Last date to apply: 26-10-26.

dates.event: Opening Date for Submission of Online Applications
Last Date for Submission of Online Applications

howToApply: Visit the official website www.npcilcareers.co.in and click on ‘Apply => Online Registration’.
Step 1 – Registration: Fill in basic information such as Name, Date of Birth, Category, Email, and Mobile Number. An activation link will be sent to your registered email.
Step 2 – Activation: Click on the activation link received via email to activate your account.

Step 3 – Fill Application: Login using your Login ID and Password. Fill in all details including Educational Qualifications, Marks of CA/CMA, Personal Details, and upload scanned Photograph (JPEG, max 50KB, max 480×640 pixels, min 10KB, min 180×240 pixels) and Signature (JPEG, max 20KB, max 160×560 pixels, min 80×100 pixels).
Step 4 – Submit Application: Review the draft application, make any necessary corrections, and submit. An Application Number will be generated upon successful submission.
Step 5 – Print Application Form: After submission, view and print the Online Application Form.
There is NO application fee for applying for the Internship.
Do NOT send any documents/application to NPCIL by post or in person.

title: Local Self Government Rajasthan Recruitment 2026 – Contractual Safai Karmachari (Last Date Extended) Posts
shortInfo: Local Self Government Rajasthan has announced notification for Contractual Safai Karmachari (Last Date Extended) posts. Required qualification: 1 year experience in sanitation/cleaning. Last date to apply: 28-10-26.

vacancyList.postName: Contractual Safai Karmachari (Sanvida Safai Karmachari) - Non-Scheduled Area
Contractual Safai Karmachari (Sanvida Safai Karmachari) - Scheduled Area

howToApply: Visit the department’s online portal at https://lsg.urban.rajasthan.gov.in/ or SSO portal at https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in and login.
After login, select ‘Recruitment Portal’ available under Citizen Apps (G2C) and click on ‘Apply Now’.
If One Time Registration (OTR) fee has not been paid, first complete OTR by selecting your category (Unreserved/Reserved), disability status, and home state, then pay the registration fee.
After completing OTR, fill the online application form carefully. Information entered during OTR (name, father’s name, date of birth, gender, ID details) cannot be modified.
Capture a live photo during the application process and submit the application.
Fill in the visible mark (drishya chinh) in the online application form.
After submission, an Application ID will be generated. If no Application ID is received, the application has not been submitted successfully.
Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.
Applications can also be filled through designated e-Mitra Kiosks / Jan Suvidha Kendras.
Applicants can apply for only ONE Urban Local Body (ULB) out of the 183 advertised. Applying to more than one ULB will result in cancellation of all applications.
